text:
alina: Received a SIG/CAIQ from ProspectNet (uploaded). They need responses + evidence by next Wed for procurement. Raising hand for owner.

sasha: FYI POC is live this week. Sales needs clarity on BYOK/KMS and data residency for pricing. Can security own the questionnaire intake?

marc: Quick skim — looks standard, a handful of BYOK/KMS Qs plus some network diagram asks. I can draft infra answers but will need compliance signoff for some.

jamal: I can take ownership. ETA to complete draft answers + gather evidence is Tue EOD. Need access to their questionnaire link and any previous templates (SolarisCo) we used.

alina: Link uploaded: https://redwood.share/prospectnet/SIG-2026 (also added procurement email). Can sec-bot open a ticket?

sec-bot: Ticket created: SEC-2026-834. Assigned to jamal. ETA field set to 2026-03-24. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/SEC-2026-834

sasha: @jamal can you flag any answers that would change pricing (BYOK/HSM, dedicated region, HIPAA)? Sales needs clear callouts for the SOW.

jamal: Will annotate. Initial notes: BYOK supported via KMS integration but HSM-backed BYOK requires additional setup + monthly fee. Dedicated EU region available on Redwood Dedicated (cost uplift). HIPAA covered for Private + Dedicated with BAA; hosted requires contract addendum.

marc: For infra evidence I'll collect network diagram and latest pentest. Where should I drop artifacts?

jamal: Drop in /shared/sec-evidence/prospectnet/SEC-2026-834 or attach to the ticket. We need SOC2 cert and pentest PDF (please redact internal IPs).

alina: I'll prep a redacted SOC2 and send to jamal. Also sales asked: can we provide a short yes/no summary for procurement within 24h?

jamal: I can do a high-level yes/no summary tomorrow AM. Full questionnaire by Tue EOD.

sasha: Perfect — I'll update deal checklist and note pricing implications. Ping me when the summary is posted. :thumbsup: 

sec-bot: Reminder set for jamal in 24h.

jamal: One potential blocker — need confirmation if they require HSM-backed BYOK (true HSM) vs KMS-managed keys. alina, can you double-check with the customer?

alina: On it, asking now and will paste reply here.

alina: Customer replied: "We require HSM BYOK for keys at rest." Marking HSM required. Jamal — moved ETA to Mon EOD to prioritize, ok?

jamal: Ok will prioritize and update ticket SEC-2026-834 with HSM callouts and pricing impact.
